output.name: evalify
output.purpose: Calibrate judgments already made by the invoking agent using deterministic framework assertions.

criteria.description: Define the actual workload and observable success, including deterministic gates.
Calibrate any model judge against independently labeled examples and record limitations.
Retain matched runs, elapsed time, costs, failures and confirmation evidence.

limits: Recorded source identity and per-case timings cannot authenticate the invoking host or judge calibration.
The helper performs no inference, model selection, provider selection, or agent-harness launch.
Detached subprocesses and remote effects are outside the local deadline.
